headlines.title: 'K-국부펀드' 설립 논의 시작 …" 상반기 중 방안 마련 "
headlines.summary: 재경부, 한국판 국부펀드 설립 방향 논의 위한 간담회 "유망산업에 장기 지분 투자…미래 세대와 국부 나눌 것" "상반기 중 설립 방안 마련하고 국회에 법안 제출 예정" [세종=뉴시스] 강종민 기자 = 세종시 어진동 정부세종청사 재정경제부. 2026.01.06. ppkjm@newsis.

headlines.title: 임광현 국세청장 “ 다주택자 편법 증여, 가산세 40% 물 수도 ”
headlines.summary: SNS 통해 편법증여 전수 검증 예고 “정상이면 양도가 증여보다 부담적어” 다음달 9일 다주택자 양도소득세 중과 유예가 종료되는 가운데 임광현 국세청장이 29일 세금을 피하기 위한 다주택자들의 편법 증여를 철저하게 검증하겠다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 서울 60㎡ 이하 소형 아파트 평균가 10억 넘었다
headlines.summary: 대출 규제·전세난에 중저가 매수 쏠림 6개월새 11%↑, 모든 면적 중 상승률 최고 “구매력 부족 실수요자, 작은 아파트 몰려” 서울의 60㎡ 이하 소형 아파트 평균 가격이 처음으로 10억원을 돌파했다. 대출 한도 축소가 덜한 중저가 아파트로 매수세가 모이며, ‘좁은 집’의 몸값이 폭등하고 있는 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 정부 ‘ 건설사 구하기 ’… 표준단가 공시 연기
headlines.summary: 예년보다 일주일 늦춰 내달 8일 중동전쟁 여파 물가인상분 반영 중동전쟁 장기화에 따른 공사비 급등으로 건설사들의 부담이 커지자 정부가 건설사 구하기에 나섰다. 올해 하반기 발주될 공공 공사의 표준 단가 발표 시기를 일주일가량 연기해 전쟁에 따른 물가 인상분을 최대한 반영하기로 한 것이다.

headlines.title: 나프타 보조금에 업계 ‘ 숨통 ’… 스폿 물량 확보
headlines.summary: 여천NCC 가동률 55 → 65% 극단적인 공급절벽 상황 완화 원료값 비싸 ‘역마진’은 여전 미국·이란 전쟁발 나프타 수급난에 직격탄을 맞았던 국내 석유화학기업들이 나프타분해시설(NCC) 가동률을 높이면서 극한 위기 상황은 넘어간 것으로 분석됐다.

headlines.title: 중동사태에 기업들 투자 미루고 부채상환
headlines.summary: 지난달 회사채 잔액 0.2% 감소 발행 목적도 차환 용도가 85% 시설 투자 위한 발행액은 ‘제로’ 중동 전쟁과 고금리 여파로 불확실성이 커지면서 기업들이 미래를 위한 투자보다는 당장의 생존을 위해 부채 상환에 주력하는 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 원전 업계, 해외 진출 경험 부족... 정부 "첫걸음 지원 강화 "
headlines.summary: <연합뉴스> 정부가 원전 수출 업계를 돕기 위해 해외인증 취득 등 수출지원사업을 확대한다. 수출실적이 부족한 중소·중견기업엔 '수출 첫걸음 지원정책'을 강화한다. 산업통상자원부는 20일 한국원전수출산업협회와 공동으로 '원전 기업을 위한 수출 설명회'를 갖고 이같이 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 뽑겠다는 중기, 일하겠다는 외국인 … 현장선 ‘ 미스매치 ’ 심각
headlines.summary: 중진공, 중기·유학생 대상 조사 기업·외국인 약 80% ‘채용·취업 희망’ 정부·지자체, 공공 취업매칭 강화 필요 네팔에서 온 외국인 근로자들이 인천국제공항 제2터미널을 통해 입국하고 있다.  [뉴시스] 중소기업 10곳 중 8곳가량은 외국인 유학생과 구직자를 채용할 의향이 있는 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 女 가사노동 가치 연 1천650만원 … 성별 격차 3.2→2.7배로 축소

headlines.title: 돈 안 받는 집안일도 GDP 23% 규모 … 582조 가치

key_headlines.title: Seoul Small Apartments Under 60 Square Meters Exceed 1 Billion Won Average Price
key_headlines.summary: Small apartments in Seoul have surpassed the 1 billion won average price mark for the first time, driven by stricter loan regulations and demand concentration from buyers with limited purchasing power, recording the highest price increase among all apartment sizes at 11% over six months.

key_headlines.title: Government Delays Standard Construction Cost Announcement to Support Builders
key_headlines.summary: The government postponed the announcement of standard construction costs by one week to May 8th to reflect price increases caused by prolonged Middle East conflict and rising material costs.

key_headlines.title: Youth Unemployment Rate Reaches 7.4%, Highest in Four Years
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's youth unemployment rate reached 7.4% in the first quarter of 2026, the highest level since 2021, while the government and business community organize a major job fair with 700 participating companies.

key_headlines.title: Korea's 10-Year Expected Inflation Exceeds Base Rate Amid Geopolitical Concerns
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's 10-year expected inflation rose from 2.45% to 2.76% following the Iran-related developments, now exceeding the current base rate and suggesting stronger upward pressure on prices.

The government is supporting struggling construction companies by postponing standard cost announcements to factor in Middle East conflict-related price increases. Domestic petrochemical firms are gaining breathing room through naphtha spot market acquisitions, with NCC operating rates improving despite persistent margin pressures.

Canada is experiencing a 1.5 percentage point GDP growth reduction following U.S. tariff increases, with manufacturing employment also declining. Busan has achieved its lowest unemployment rate in five years at 2.5% while adding 100,000 regular jobs over the past five years. Youth unemployment has reached a concerning 7.4%, prompting the government and business community to organize large-scale recruitment fairs with 700 participating companies.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSDAQ has rebounded with strong ETF activity despite retail investors showing caution, while semiconductor leaders face consolidation in a volatile environment. Central banks hold rates steady, but long-term interest rates are rising rapidly as inflation and fiscal deficit concerns push markets toward tighter monetary conditions, with JPMorgan's Dimon warning of an impending bond crisis. Margin trading in the domestic stock market has reached record highs at 35.69 trillion won, growing continuously over 13 consecutive trading days as the KOSPI sets new records. The KOSPI closed at 6,690.90 points (up 0.75%), supported by individual and institutional buying, while the won-dollar exchange rate settled at 1,479.0 won per dollar. Electric vehicles are regaining market attention due to high oil prices, with Samsung SDI supplying NCM batteries to Mercedes-Benz and LG Energy Solutions securing major contracts.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea and Qatar agreed to expand investment cooperation in manufacturing AI, robots, biotechnology, and semiconductors, marking a shift beyond energy-focused partnerships toward advanced industry collaboration. The government is promoting small modular reactor (SMR) ship technology by combining nuclear and shipbuilding expertise to enable extended operations without fuel replacement while reducing carbon emissions. South Korea aims to become an energy-exporting nation by securing independent hydrogen technology and integrating hydrogen infrastructure with nuclear power capabilities. The government has restructured electric vehicle public charging fee systems into five tiers and reduced slow-charging rates to 294.3 won per kilowatt-hour, expanding accessibility. Manufacturing AI transformation (M.AX) and semiconductor equipment supply chains remain strategic priorities for industrial development.
sections.Real Estate: Presidential candidates are competing with rival housing development policies, with one proposing to accelerate redevelopment and reconstruction projects to within 10 years to increase Seoul's housing supply. Multi-unit villa owners face potential reverse jeonse (lease deposit) issues as deposit return guarantee requirements tighten from July, with some owners forced to reduce guarantees by 15 million won or more. Korean Investment Real Estate Trust signed an MOU for redevelopment cooperation in the Sillim District 6 area, representing active participation in housing redevelopment projects. Housing redevelopment and reconstruction debates have intensified ahead of the Seoul mayoral election, with competing visions on implementation speed and procedures.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. Federal Reserve is confirmed to hold its base rate at 3.5-3.75% at the concluding FOMC meeting on April 29th, maintaining its current monetary policy stance. Jerome Powell's tenure as Fed chairman ends on May 15th, with significant attention on whether he will continue as a board member with two years remaining on his director term. Bitcoin declined to the 76,000 dollar level ahead of the FOMC decision, as cryptocurrency markets monitor the Fed's policy implications closely. Former Fed Vice Chairman Roger Ferguson noted that internal conflicts are inevitable as the Fed balances its dual mandate of price stability and employment, making rate cuts difficult under current conditions. China is offering duty-free benefits to 53 African countries (excluding Taiwan's diplomatic partners) starting next month, reinforcing Africa-focused economic and trade partnerships.
sections.AI & Economy: Busan announced a program to support AI companies by covering up to 90% of GPU computational infrastructure costs with maximum subsidies of 30 million won, lowering barriers to high-performance computing access for startups and SMEs. U.S. data center power equipment spending is projected to reach 65 billion dollars by 2030, driven by accelerating AI infrastructure competition and rapid data center expansion, creating significant opportunities for domestic technology companies with power equipment capabilities. LG Electronics is positioning AI as essential infrastructure while strengthening its appliance business and exploring growth through robotics and data center ventures. The government's 2027 R&D budget will prioritize manufacturing AI transformation (M.AX) and the '5 Poles 3 Specialties' growth engines through strategic investments focused on high-impact outcomes. LaOn Secure decided to cancel 994,000 shares worth 1.24 billion won to enhance shareholder value and participate in the government's value-up program while strengthening market trust.
sections.Others: Youth employment through government new deal programs remains limited, with positions in tax and farmland surveys providing only 13,500 temporary jobs, falling far short of potential capacity. NH-Amundi Asset Management surpassed 100 trillion won in total assets under management as of April 24th, with approximately 30 trillion won growth in just one year, primarily driven by equity fund performance. AI bubble concerns resurfaced following OpenAI's earnings slowdown reports, weighing on U.S. stock indices on April 28th with the NASDAQ down 0.9%, focusing market attention on major tech earnings releases. TechTaka participated in Amazon's 2026 AI Day, presenting integrated logistics solutions for Korean sellers covering international shipping, customs clearance, FBA warehouse delivery, and tariff handling. Experts debate AI governance as Google DeepMind CEO predicts general artificial intelligence (AGI) arrival within five years with 10 times greater impact than industrial revolutions, raising critical questions about labor and societal transformation frameworks.
